candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 State By Decile
candidates.description: Income and Tax data organized by income (AGI) decile.  Out-of-state filers are not included in decile analysis but totals are listed on a separate line. Out-of-state filers with income adjustments of 0 (meaning they had no Vermont income) were excluded entirely.

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 State By TI Bracket
candidates.description: This report shows income and tax statistics for all Vermont residents organized by Vermont taxable income bracket.  Out-of-state filers were excluded from the analysis but their totals are reported on a separate line.  Out-of-state filers with income adjsutment equal to zero (meaning they had no VT income) were excluded entirely.

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 State By AGI Bracket
candidates.description: This report shows income and tax statistics for all Vermont residents organized by AGI income bracket.  Out-of-state filers were excluded from the analysis but their totals are reported on a separate line.  Out-of-state filers with income adjsutment equal to zero (meaning they had no VT income) were excluded entirely.

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 Town
candidates.description: Income and Tax statistics by town for calendar year 2014.  Towns with fewer than ten returns have been aggregated into the row called "Suppressed."

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 - Under 65
candidates.description: This report looks at income and tax statistics for filers under the age of 65 organized by income (AGI) bracket.  Out-of-state filers are excluded from the analysis but their totals are included on a separate line.

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 State - 65 And Over
candidates.description: This report looks at income and tax statistics for filers age 65 and up organized by income (AGI) bracket.  Out-of-state filers are excluded from the analysis but their totals are included on a separate line.

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 Family By County
candidates.description: This report shows 2014 Vermont income and tax data for families (those filing as joint or head of household) oreganzied by Vermont county.

candidates.title: Income Stats 2014 Family By Town
candidates.description: This report shows income statistics for Vermont Filers (those filing as joint or head of household) organized by Vermont town.

candidates.title: Town Median Income 2014 All Returns
candidates.description:
This report is provided for historical continuity with previous reports.  Median AGI for all tax returns is not an inappropriate measure of central tendency because it is so dependent on the mix of single and dual (joint) incomes within a town.

Determination of median AGI for all tax returns by town was required by VSA Title 16, Section 3480 in 1981 to assist in computation of aid to education.  In 1987 this statute section was amended to specify determination of average AGI per exemption.  The entire section was repealed in 1997 as part of Act 60.

candidates.title: Town Property Tax Adjustment Summary
candidates.description: This file shows the total counts and amounts of property tax adjustments and renter rebates by town.  The property tax adjustments were applied to households' FY16 property tax bills.
